cc:Work.dc:title: Choosing compressed segments for compaction
cc:Work.dc:description: Native user-space compressed-segment compaction; 9 paired trials per policy/scenario. Cell values are medians of 100*(1-alternative/FIFO), including selection overhead. Real compressed corpus payloads, replicated as disclosed in the manifest; synthetic deletion layouts. Full-reclaim rows are negative controls with identical copied/released bytes. No full Apple-policy or kernel improvement claim. Source SHA-256 cffe40f7fd406ac3c1b8945d22e799338cd923d1768c6d6780443c68e0a07b69. Rendered with Matplotlib 3.10.9.
